description: This PHP source file defines the ResourceServer class within the SuiteCRM OAuth2 middleware, handling OAuth2 token validation, user retrieval, and request authorization logic.

classes.name: ResourceServer
classes.description: Middleware class for handling OAuth2 resource server validation, user context setting, and request authorization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ResourceServer with an OAuth2 ResourceServer instance.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles incoming requests, validates OAuth2 tokens unless route is exempt, and sets current user context.

methods.name: setCurrentUserGlobal
methods.description: Sets the global current_user variable based on the OAuth2 authenticated user, throws exception if user is inactive.

methods.name: getUserFromRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the User object associated with the OAuth2 token, falling back to client’s assigned user if necessary.
